evidence: Cic. Fin. 5.2: tanta vīs admonitiōnis inest in locīs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: No reference work has a word for a phone’s notification. Classically admonitiō is a reminding, something that calls a matter to mind, which is what a notification does; a message itself is nūntius (see text message).
Traupman’s word for a prompt on a screen; classically a warning, in prose chiefly an omen (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: admonitio · Lewis & Short: monitus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
No source has a word for a notification.
